title_zh: 英伟达董事会一致通过，黄仁勋恢复 CEO 职务
content_zh:
当地时间 11 月 23 日，黄仁勋返回英伟达位于加州圣克拉拉的总部，受到员工的欢呼和掌声欢迎。他在现场开玩笑称：「这是我第一天上班，我还没有电脑，所以 IT 部门会给我配一台新的。」

随后，黄仁勋向员工道歉，承认自己犯下了严重错误，并表示将努力弥补。他感谢员工给予自己第二次担任 CEO 的机会，承诺「这一次我会做得更好」。

昨晚，英伟达宣布，董事会一致投票通过，恢复黄仁勋的公司总裁、CEO 和董事职务，决定即刻生效。从 11 月 12 日突然辞职，到重新执掌英伟达，这场持续 11 天的管理层风波暂告一段落。

公司向美国证券交易委员会提交的文件显示，董事会于当地时间 11 月 22 日作出上述决定。此前在 11 月 17 日的财报电话会上，英伟达还曾表示无意让黄仁勋复任 CEO。董事会表示，在与黄仁勋多轮沟通，并听取美国政府高层意见后，认为其复职符合公司及股东利益。

黄仁勋回归的消息也推动英伟达股价大幅反弹。当地时间 11 月 23 日，英伟达收涨 31.48%，报每股 165.05 美元，单日上涨 39.52 美元，市值回升至约 3.98 万亿美元。

黄仁勋虽然已经回归，但围绕他的调查仍在继续。英伟达此前成立的独立董事委员会将继续调查其被指成为外国情报活动目标一事，公司还新设国家安全与出口管制委员会，加强对贸易合规及相关风险的监督，并着手物色首席合规官。

此外，黄仁勋预计将于 12 月 3 日出席美国参议院银行委员会举行的公开听证会，接受有关美国出口管制监督问题的质询。

🔗 相关阅读：刚刚，黄仁勋重返英伟达！董事会全票通过，盘前大涨 30%
title_en: Jensen Huang Reinstated as Nvidia CEO Following Unanimous Board Vote
content_en:
Jensen Huang has officially resumed his roles as President, CEO, and Director of Nvidia after a unanimous vote by the company’s board of directors, bringing an end to an 11-day leadership crisis triggered by his sudden resignation on November 12.

Returning to Nvidia's headquarters in Santa Clara, California, on November 23, Huang addressed cheering employees, acknowledged past mistakes, and thanked staff for giving him a second chance to lead the semiconductor giant.

According to SEC filings, the board reversed its stance following extensive discussions with Huang and consultation with senior U.S. government officials, concluding that his reinstatement serves the best interests of Nvidia and its shareholders. The news triggered a sharp market rally, with Nvidia stock surging 31.48% on November 23 to close at $165.05 per share, pushing its market capitalization back up to approximately $3.98 trillion.

Despite his return, Huang and Nvidia remain under regulatory scrutiny. An independent board committee continues to investigate allegations regarding foreign intelligence targeting, while the company has established a new National Security and Export Control Committee to strengthen trade compliance. Huang is also scheduled to testify before the U.S. Senate Banking Committee on December 3 regarding export control oversight.

title_zh: 高校免费发 Token 给师生，上海财经大学每人每周最高 1 亿
content_zh:
上海财经大学近日宣布，为每位师生提供每周最高 1 亿 Token 的使用额度。师生通过校内统一身份认证，就能按需调用多种大模型和智能工具。

学校希望把这种按模型处理量计量的资源纳入日常教学，学生可用于调试代码和清洗数据，教师也可用来搭建课程知识库。

额度由学校统一调度。上财在校庆活动上接受了阿里巴巴捐赠的 Token 资源，并将其与校内平台、校企共建算力等一起纳入服务体系。「匡时一号」算力平台 2.0 自今年 7 月上线后，已覆盖 13 个学院，运行教学科研任务 7300 余次。

据澎湃新闻报道，也有高校选择按天发放额度。国家超级计算长沙中心向湖南大学师生开放大模型 API，为每位用户预设每天 200 万 Token 的基础额度，限校园网访问。
title_en: Chinese Universities Offer Free AI Tokens to Students and Faculty, Led by SUFE's 100M Weekly Grant
content_en:
Shanghai University of Finance and Economics (SUFE) has announced a new initiative providing faculty and students with up to 100 million AI tokens per week. Accessible via the university's unified authentication system, the program allows users to leverage multiple large language models and AI tools for code debugging, data processing, and building specialized course knowledge bases.

The compute resources are managed centrally by the university, supported in part by a major donation of AI tokens from Alibaba Group. These resources are integrated with SUFE's "Kuangshi No. 1" 2.0 computing platform, which has supported over 7,300 academic and research tasks across 13 colleges since its upgrade in July.

SUFE is part of a broader trend among Chinese academic institutions integrating generative AI into campus life. Similarly, the National Supercomputing Center in Changsha has opened model API access to Hunan University staff and students, offering a baseline daily allocation of 2 million tokens over the campus network.

title_zh: Meta 首席 AI 官 Alexandr Wang：实验、数据和领域知识将成为 AI 进展的瓶颈
content_zh:
北京时间 11 月 23 日，Meta 首席 AI 官 Alexandr Wang 在长文《Superintelligence is Arriving》中判断，高水平 AI 在更多领域取得进展，接下来要解决的难题会越来越集中在领域知识、实验和反馈机制上。他用两次数学进展解释这个判断。

他回顾了 2024 年底 OpenAI o3 在美国数学邀请赛 AIME 上的表现。在他看来，竞赛难题的抽象推理门槛已经很高，模型要把这些能力用到工程和商业工作中，还得补上实际情境、行业知识和工作流程。眼下有关黎曼猜想的 AI 辅助证明研究，则让他把同样的判断推到更多科学领域。

Wang 也谈到实验和数据的作用。他指出，许多学科的问题在纯推理上未必比这道数学题更难，但现实研究还需要获取数据、设计实验和建立反馈。他由此判断，模型可能在不同领域迅速取得进展，人类理解和监督这些进展的速度也会面临压力。

他呼吁行业同时推进安全、对齐和防护，并把扩大人的自主权作为技术目标。他认为，如果模型获得不受约束的递归自我改进能力，人类将很难维持控制。
title_en: Meta Chief AI Officer Alexandr Wang Identifies Domain Knowledge and Data as Next AI Bottlenecks
content_en:
In a newly published essay titled *Superintelligence is Arriving*, Meta Chief AI Officer Alexandr Wang argued that the next phase of artificial intelligence development will be constrained primarily by domain knowledge, empirical experimentation, and feedback mechanisms rather than raw abstract reasoning.

Reflecting on recent breakthroughs, such as OpenAI's o3 model performing on advanced mathematical competitions, Wang noted that translating high-level reasoning into practical engineering, scientific, and business applications requires real-world context, specialized industry workflows, and continuous data acquisition. In scientific domains, progress relies heavily on experimental design and rapid feedback loops alongside model reasoning.

Wang also emphasized the urgent need to advance safety protocols, alignment, and technical safeguards alongside rapid capability gains. He urged the industry to make expanding human agency a primary goal, warning that unconstrained recursive self-improvement could make it difficult for humanity to maintain oversight.

title_zh: 知乎参投基金间接入股 DeepSeek
content_zh:
知乎 11 月 23 日在港交所公告，其参投的天津砺思星深股权投资基金已通过投资主体入股 DeepSeek，取得低个位数百分比的股权。知乎是这只基金的有限合伙人，在基金中的权益比例低于 30%。

知乎在 10 月完成基金份额认购。公司董事会表示，希望通过这只基金接触更多 AI 和科技企业的投资机会，并了解 AI 产品和商业模式的发展。
title_en: Zhihu Indirectly Acquires Stake in AI Startup DeepSeek via Venture Fund
content_en:
Chinese Q&A platform Zhihu announced on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange on November 23 that Tianjin Lisi Xingshen Equity Investment Fund, a venture fund in which it holds an interest, has indirectly acquired a low single-digit percentage equity stake in AI startup DeepSeek. Zhihu serves as a limited partner (LP) in the fund with an equity share of less than 30%.

Zhihu completed its fund subscription in October. According to its board of directors, the investment aims to expand the company's exposure to emerging opportunities across the AI and technology sectors while deepening its understanding of AI product development and commercial models.

title_zh: GPT-6.2 Sol 开始推送到 ChatGPT 对话页
content_zh:
OpenAI 11 月 23 日开始在 ChatGPT 的「对话」页推送针对日常交流调校的 GPT-6.2 Sol。首批覆盖 Plus、Pro、Business 和 Enterprise，Enterprise 工作区由管理员控制模型访问权限。

这次更新让模型处理截图、复杂指令和网页检索时更可靠，也调整了追问时机。比如用户问某件商品是否打折，ChatGPT 可以主动询问是否需要在降价时发出提醒。GPT-6.2 Astra 和 Sol 此前已在 ChatGPT Work 和 Codex 开放预览。
title_en: OpenAI Rolls Out GPT-6.2 Sol to ChatGPT Chat Interface
content_en:
OpenAI began rolling out GPT-6.2 Sol—a model fine-tuned for everyday conversation—to the main ChatGPT chat interface on November 23. The initial rollout covers Plus, Pro, Business, and Enterprise subscribers, with Enterprise access managed by workspace administrators.

The update improves reliability when processing screenshots, complex prompts, and web retrieval, while also refining follow-up behavior. For instance, if a user inquires whether a product is on sale, ChatGPT can proactively offer to send price-drop alerts. Both GPT-6.2 Sol and GPT-6.2 Astra were previously available in preview mode on ChatGPT Work and Codex.

title_zh: Steam 大奖开放提名，往届年度游戏将角逐名人堂奖
content_zh:
Steam 大奖进入第十年，Valve 已开放本届提名，并新增名人堂奖。这个奖项把往届年度游戏得主放在一起，由玩家选出过去十年的代表作。2016 年首届 Steam 大奖没有「年度游戏」奖，Valve 为这一届指定了对应奖项的获奖作品参加。

本轮提名到北京时间 12 月 1 日凌晨 2 点截止，最终投票于 12 月 17 日开启。符合 Steam 资格要求的非受限账户可以提名和投票。
title_en: 10th Steam Awards Opens Nominations, Introducing Hall of Fame Category
content_en:
Marking the 10th anniversary of the Steam Awards, Valve has officially opened nominations for this year's event, featuring a newly created Hall of Fame category. The award pits past Game of the Year winners against one another, allowing players to select the defining title of the past decade. Since the inaugural 2016 awards did not include an official Game of the Year category, Valve designated a representative winner from that year to join the race.

Nominations close on December 1 at 2:00 AM (Beijing Time), with final voting set to launch on December 17. All eligible, non-limited Steam accounts can participate in nominating and voting.

title_zh: 蚂蚁领投人形机器人公司至简动力，创始人称本轮融资 1 亿美元
content_zh: 据彭博社 11 月 23 日报道，人形机器人公司至简动力完成由蚂蚁集团领投的 Pre-A 轮融资，规模为 1 亿美元。至简动力董事长、联合创始人王凯向彭博社表示，本轮融资对公司的估值为 16 亿美元，腾讯、红杉中国和蓝驰创投等现有投资方也参与了这一轮。
title_en: Ant Group Leads $100 Million Funding Round for Humanoid Robotics Startup Zhijian Dongli
content_en:
Humanoid robotics startup Zhijian Dongli has raised $100 million in a Pre-A funding round led by Ant Group, Bloomberg reported on November 23.

The new round values the company at $1.6 billion, according to Kai Wang, chairman and co-founder of Zhijian Dongli. Existing investors, including Tencent, Sequoia China, and BlueRun Ventures, also participated in the round.

title_zh: 四部门鼓励养老机构和社区试用服务机器人、智能穿戴设备
content_zh:
国家发展改革委、民政部、国家卫生健康委和教育部 11 月 23 日公布「一老一小」服务体系建设实施方案。

方案提出，鼓励开发适合养老场景的人工智能体、服务机器人、智能穿戴设备和外骨骼，支持在养老机构和社区应用这类产品或设置体验区。

方案还提出推动养老机构配置智能健康监测设备和辅助器具。到 2030 年，方案设定的目标包括养老机构护理型床位占比达到 73%，社区养老服务机构和设施覆盖率达到 70%。
title_en: China Encourages Senior Care Facilities to Adopt Service Robots and Smart Wearables
content_en:
Four Chinese government agencies, including the National Development and Reform Commission and the Ministry of Civil Affairs, unveiled an implementation plan on November 23 to enhance care services for the elderly and children.

The plan encourages the development and deployment of AI agents, service robots, smart wearables, and exoskeletons tailored for senior care. It supports integrating these technologies into nursing homes and local communities, alongside equipping facilities with smart health-monitoring tools.

By 2030, the initiative aims to increase the proportion of nursing-care beds in senior care institutions to 73% and extend community elderly care service coverage to 70%.

title_zh: 💡 钟南山谈医学 AI：回答要有循证依据，诊治仍由医生决定
content_zh:
11 月 23 日，中国工程院院士钟南山在蚂蚁阿福医疗健康生态大会上说，医学容不得半点「差不多」。他认为，专业医学 AI 回答问题时应给出可追溯的循证依据。

他希望这类工具让更多普通人看得上病、看得好病，也看得明白病。回答的依据和证据强度应能跟着建议一起被核查。

他把基层医疗作为一个应用场景。钟南山认为，专业 AI 可以为基层和偏远地区的患者提供权威、规范的健康指导和就医参考，让不同地区获得的服务更接近。

他还提到，人口老龄化带来的慢性病管理，以及公共卫生挑战，都是专业医学 AI 可以发挥作用的领域。

谈到医生怎么用 AI，钟南山说，它可以分担复杂的事务性工作，让医生腾出时间。医患交流仍是建立信任的关键，最终如何诊治，应由医生作出决定。
title_en: Medical AI Must Be Evidence-Based and Doctor-Led, Says Top Chinese Expert Zhong Nanshan
content_en:
Speaking at a healthcare conference on November 23, renowned Chinese epidemiologist Zhong Nanshan stressed that medical AI must strictly adhere to evidence-based standards. He emphasized that medical care leaves no room for guesswork, and AI tools should provide verifiable evidence alongside their recommendations to make quality care more transparent and accessible.

Zhong identified primary healthcare in remote areas as a key application, noting that AI can deliver standardized guidance to help narrow regional care gaps. He added that AI could also play a vital role in managing chronic diseases associated with an aging population and addressing broader public health challenges.

Regarding the role of physicians, Zhong noted that while AI can offload routine administrative tasks to free up doctors' time, human interaction remains essential to building patient trust. Ultimately, final diagnostic and treatment decisions must always rest with doctors.

title_zh: 智谱 GLM-5.4 上线编程订阅，新增读图能力
content_zh:
11 月 23 日，智谱全球站负责人李子玄宣布，GLM-5.4 已向所有 GLM Coding Plan 用户开放。新版可以读取图片。对设有每周额度的订阅用户，GLM-5.4 的周额度比 GLM-5.3 多 50%。

智谱当天发布的技术说明确认，GLM-5.4 是公司首款采用 Loop Transformer 的旗舰模型。它将 GLM-5 基座中的 28 层循环执行两轮，复用同一组权重来增加推理深度。模型已同步上线 ZCode、Trae 等平台，API 将在完成安全评估后开放，模型权重计划开源。

编程博主 AICodeKing 在他自设的 KingBench 4 测试中，用六个编程项目评估模型生成的应用，将 GLM-5.4 排在第七。他认为，模型在理解复杂工程的整体结构上表现较好，可以用于规划和代码审查。

另据第一财经报道，智谱管理层预计在 12 月推出下一款旗舰模型 GLM-5.5，参数规模约为 3 万亿。
title_en: Zhipu AI Launches GLM-5.4 with Vision Capabilities and Loop Transformer Architecture
content_en:
Zhipu AI has officially made GLM-5.4 available to all GLM Coding Plan subscribers. The updated model introduces image recognition capabilities, and weekly subscribers will receive a 50% quota increase compared to GLM-5.3.

Technically, GLM-5.4 is Zhipu’s first flagship model built on a Loop Transformer architecture. By executing the 28 layers of the GLM-5 base twice using shared weights, it significantly deepens reasoning performance. The model is currently live on platforms like ZCode and Trae, with its API set to open following safety evaluations and weights slated for open-source release.

In independent benchmarks by tech blogger AICodeKing, GLM-5.4 ranked seventh across six coding projects, demonstrating strong capabilities in high-level architectural comprehension, planning, and code review. Additionally, reports indicate Zhipu plans to launch its next-generation 3-trillion-parameter GLM-5.5 model in December.

title_zh: 蚂蚁阿福同款医疗大模型开源，笔记本电脑也能部署专业医疗 AI
content_zh:
11 月 23 日，蚂蚁宣布开源百灵医疗健康大模型 LingSante 家族中的两款核心模型。

其中，LingSante-3.1-air-VL 参数量为 124B，支持文字、图片和视频理解，可在笔记本电脑等本地设备部署。LingSante-3.1-flash 总参数量达 560B，支持最长 1M Token 上下文，面向复杂医学推理和专业医疗任务。

两款模型均已应用于蚂蚁阿福。此次开源将向全球医疗机构、科研团队和开发者开放，降低专业医疗 AI的使用和研发门槛。
title_en: Ant Group Open-Sources Core Healthcare AI Models Behind "Afu" Medical Assistant
content_en:
Ant Group has announced the open-sourcing of two core models from its LingSante healthcare family. These models power Ant's flagship consumer medical AI assistant, "Afu," and aim to lower the development barrier for global medical institutions, researchers, and developers.

The release includes `LingSante-3.1-air-VL`, a 124-billion-parameter multimodal model capable of processing text, images, and video that can run locally on standard hardware like laptops. The second model, `LingSante-3.1-flash`, features 560 billion parameters and a 1-million-token context window, optimized for complex medical reasoning and advanced clinical applications.

title_zh: 自变量发布具身模型 API，让机器人在预训练阶段学习动作
content_zh:
11 月 23 日，自变量发布新一代具身基础模型 WALL-OSS-1.0，并推出面向开发者的 WALL-API-1.0。模型在预训练时就同时学习语言、图像和机器人动作，设计目标是让机器人把学过的操作方法用到陌生物体和新任务上。

自变量称，在评估人员自由选定的 312 项真机任务中，模型在无需任务示范和专项微调的情况下完成了 55.1%。测试包含工具使用、双臂协作和多步骤操作。公司另行提供任务规划框架 XR Harness 的开发者预览版。开发者可在官方文档查看接入要求并申请 API 密钥。
title_en: Zibianliang Debuts Embodied AI Model API Featuring Direct Pre-Training Action Learning
content_en:
Robotics startup Zibianliang has launched its next-generation embodied foundation model, WALL-OSS-1.0, along with the developer-oriented WALL-API-1.0. Designed to natively integrate language, vision, and physical actions during the pre-training phase, the model enables robots to apply learned operational techniques to unfamiliar objects and new tasks.

In evaluation tests spanning 312 real-world tasks—including tool manipulation, dual-arm coordination, and multi-step operations—the model achieved a 55.1% success rate without requiring prior task demonstrations or fine-tuning. Zibianliang has also released a developer preview of its task-planning framework, XR Harness, with API key applications now open.

title_zh: 腾讯格斗游戏《异人之下》将于 12 月 17 日全平台公测
content_zh:
腾讯魔方工作室 11 月 23 日宣布，3D 格斗游戏《异人之下》将于 12 月 17 日公测，覆盖 PC、iOS、安卓和鸿蒙，并公布彭于晏担任游戏代言人。

游戏改编自米二创作的漫画《一人之下》，以角色之间的近身格斗为主。玩家可以操作张楚岚、冯宝宝等原作角色，用各自的武术招式和异能对战。
title_en: Tencent's Fighting Game 'Under One Person' Sets December 17 Cross-Platform Launch
content_en:
Tencent's Morefun Studios announced that its 3D fighting game *Under One Person* (Yi Ren Zhi Xia) will officially enter open beta testing on December 17. The title will launch across multiple platforms, including PC, iOS, Android, and HarmonyOS. Taiwanese actor Eddie Peng has been named the game's official brand ambassador.

Adapted from Mi Er's popular webcomic *Under One Person*, the game focuses on close-quarters martial arts combat. Players can control iconic characters such as Zhang Chulan and Feng Baobao, leveraging their unique fighting styles and supernatural abilities in battle.

title_zh: 中国气象局与上海 AI 实验室推出地球科学科研平台
content_zh:
据央视新闻报道，中国气象局与上海人工智能实验室共同牵头研发的地球系统智能科研平台「ZHU·GE」，11 月 23 日在雄安气象人工智能国际研讨会上推出。

研究人员可以用自然语言描述课题，由平台查找文献、调用数据和模型、编写实验程序，再根据结果调整研究路线。平台已接入约 10PB 公共科学数据和首批 1PB 中国气象局授权数据，汇集约 200 万条文献记录。

平台下一步将向全国气象科教融合创新联盟成员单位开放。联盟中的高校和科研院所可通过科研词元服务使用。
title_en: China Unveils 'ZHU·GE' AI Platform to Advance Earth Science Research
content_en:
The China Meteorological Administration (CMA) and the Shanghai Artificial Intelligence Laboratory have jointly launched "ZHU·GE," an intelligent scientific research platform tailored for Earth system studies. Unveiled on November 23 at an international meteorology AI conference in Xiongan, the platform aims to automate and streamline complex research workflows.

Researchers can prompt "ZHU·GE" using natural language. The platform automatically retrieves literature, accesses relevant datasets and models, writes experimental code, and refines research routes based on initial results. It currently connects to roughly 10 PB of public scientific data, 1 PB of authorized CMA data, and nearly 2 million literature records.

Moving forward, the platform will be made available to members of the National Meteorological Science and Education Integration Innovation Alliance, giving academic and research institutions access to specialized AI token services.

title_zh: 三星推出双模式电竞显示器，高刷模式最高 1100Hz
content_zh:
三星在美国推出 27 英寸 Odyssey G6 电竞显示器（G60H）。同一块屏幕提供两档分辨率与刷新率组合：HD 模式最高 1100Hz，切换到 2560 × 1440 则最高 600Hz。

三星在这款显示器上首次引入 Odyssey Clear Motion，用于减少高速画面中的运动模糊。显示器支持 HDR10+ Gaming，配备一个 DisplayPort 2.1 和两个 HDMI 2.1 接口。三星此前已在 8 月的 Gamescom 展示这款产品。
title_en: Samsung Launches Dual-Mode Odyssey G6 Gaming Monitor Featuring Up to 1,100Hz Refresh Rate
content_en:
Samsung has officially introduced the 27-inch Odyssey G6 gaming monitor (G60H) in the U.S. market. The monitor features a dual-mode display, allowing users to choose between an HD mode with a blistering 1,100Hz refresh rate or a QHD (2560 × 1440) resolution mode running at up to 600Hz.

The G60H marks the debut of Samsung's Odyssey Clear Motion technology, designed to significantly reduce motion blur in fast-action scenes. The monitor also supports HDR10+ Gaming and comes equipped with one DisplayPort 2.1 and two HDMI 2.1 ports. Samsung previously previewed the display at Gamescom in August.

title_zh: 小鹏 X-World 升级，可用采集路况搭建虚拟城市
content_zh:
小鹏 11 月 23 日公布辅助驾驶研发模型 X-World 1.6。研发团队可以用实车采集的数据重建道路、建筑和路口设施，再改变车流、天气和其他车辆的动作，在同一路口多次测试驾驶系统。

此前在实车测试中只遇到一次的场景，例如行人突然过街，可以用重建画面反复测试。虚拟城市还可保留地点随时间变化的信息，方便团队回放原来的路况，比较不同版本在同一场景的表现。
title_en: XPeng Unveils X-World 1.6 to Build Virtual Cities for Autonomous Driving Tests
content_en:
XPeng has officially introduced X-World 1.6, an upgraded model designed for its driver-assistance R&D. The system allows development teams to reconstruct roads, buildings, and intersection infrastructure using real-world data collected by vehicle fleets.

By tweaking traffic flow, weather conditions, and surrounding vehicle behavior, engineers can repeatedly test autonomous driving systems in simulated environments. Rare edge cases—such as a pedestrian suddenly darting across the street—can now be recreated and tested indefinitely.

Additionally, the virtual city retains historical location data over time. This enables teams to replay original road conditions and effectively benchmark different software versions within identical scenarios.

title_zh: Nothing 将发布可录音的耳机，充电盒也能录会议
content_zh:
Nothing 计划于 12 月 8 日发布 Ear (note)。据彭博社报道，Nothing 联合创始人裴宇在演示中展示了两种录音方式：充电盒的麦克风负责收录面对面会议，耳机则可以录制通话。

录音可以通过配套应用转写和生成摘要。这套设计延续了 Nothing 此前在 Ear (3a) 上推出的通话录音，把现场录音也做进了充电盒。
title_en: Nothing to Launch Ear (note) Featuring In-Person Meeting Recording via Charging Case
content_en:
Nothing is set to unveil its new wireless earbuds, the Ear (note), on December 8. According to Bloomberg, co-founder Carl Pei demonstrated dual recording capabilities: microphones built into the charging case capture in-person meetings, while the earbuds themselves record phone calls.

Audio recordings can be transcribed and summarized through a companion app. Building on the call-recording features previously introduced on the Ear (3a), this update expands Nothing's hardware-level recording capabilities directly into the charging case.

title_zh: Anthropic 推出 Claude Ship，测试自动修复代码合并请求
content_zh:
Anthropic 11 月 23 日推出 Claude Ship，将代码审查、修复和审批放进 GitHub 的拉取请求流程。产品面向 Claude Team 和 Enterprise 用户，其中 Code Review 已正式开放，PR Steward 和 Claude Approvals 进入测试。

PR Steward 可以处理持续集成检查失败、合并冲突和审查反馈，提交修复后会说明改了什么以及如何撤销。Claude Approvals 则按团队设定的政策检查改动是否可以自动获批。团队可以按仓库开启功能、保留人工审批要求，并设置用量上限。
title_en: Anthropic Launches Claude Ship to Automate GitHub Pull Request Workflows
content_en:
Anthropic has introduced Claude Ship, bringing automated code reviews, bug fixes, and approvals directly into the GitHub pull request (PR) workflow. Available for Claude Team and Enterprise subscribers, the suite officially rolls out its Code Review feature alongside beta versions of PR Steward and Claude Approvals.

The PR Steward handles failed continuous integration (CI) checks, merge conflicts, and review feedback. When submitting a fix, it clearly explains the modifications made and provides instructions on how to revert them. Meanwhile, Claude Approvals automatically evaluates code changes against team-defined policies.

Engineering teams retain full granular control, with options to enable features on a per-repository basis, maintain mandatory manual approval requirements, and set custom usage caps.

title_zh: 《复仇者联盟 5》发布终极预告，神奇四侠找上史蒂夫·罗杰斯
content_zh:
漫威发布《复仇者联盟 5》（Avengers: Doomsday）终极预告。克里斯·埃文斯饰演的史蒂夫·罗杰斯本已与佩姬过上家庭生活，神奇四侠登门，邀请他回归应对末日博士。

预告还展示了雷神、新复仇者和 X 战警同场战斗，詹姆斯·麦斯登回归饰演镭射眼，末日博士由小罗伯特·唐尼饰演。影片定于 12 月 18 日在北美上映。
title_en: Marvel Drops Final 'Avengers: Doomsday' Trailer as Fantastic Four Recruits Steve Rogers
content_en:
Marvel Studios has released the final trailer for *Avengers: Doomsday*, teasing the return of Chris Evans as Steve Rogers. Having settled into quiet family life with Peggy, Rogers is tracked down by the Fantastic Four to help defend Earth against Doctor Doom.

The action-packed preview also highlights an epic team-up featuring Thor, the New Avengers, and the X-Men. James Marsden reprises his role as Cyclops, while Robert Downey Jr. stars as Doctor Doom. The film is set to premiere in North America on December 18.

title_zh: DC 惊悚片《泥面人》开启内地预售，11 月 27 日上映
content_zh:
DC 影业的《泥面人》11 月 23 日开启中国内地预售，并发布新预告。影片由詹姆斯·瓦特金斯执导，将于 11 月 27 日在内地上映。

汤姆·里斯·哈里斯饰演一位在袭击中毁容的演员。实验性疗法让他恢复容貌，也让他的身体开始发生无法控制的变化。电影取材自 DC 漫画中哥谭市的同名反派。
title_en: DC Thriller 'Clayface' Kicks Off Pre-Sales in China Ahead of Nov 27 Release
content_en:
Pre-sales for DC Studios' upcoming thriller *Clayface* officially opened in mainland China on November 23 alongside a brand-new trailer. Directed by James Watkins, the film is slated for release on November 27.

Starring Tom Rhys Harries, the film follows an actor left disfigured after a violent attack. An experimental therapy restores his appearance, but it triggers terrifying, uncontrollable bodily mutations. The story is inspired by the legendary Gotham City villain from DC Comics.

title_zh: 《收获日出》登顶中国内地周票房
content_zh:
据财新援引国家电影专资办数据，《饥饿游戏：收获日出》在 11 月 16 日至 22 日当周以 3928.47 万元登顶中国内地票房。影片于 11 月 20 日在内地上映，结束了《神探之痕迹》和《生化危机：爆发夜》轮流领跑周榜的局面。

这部电影改编自苏珊·柯林斯的同名小说，故事从第 50 届饥饿游戏抽签的早晨开始，比系列首部电影的故事早 24 年。约瑟夫·扎达饰演年轻的黑密斯。
title_en: 'The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping' Tops China Box Office
content_en:
*The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping* claimed the top spot at the mainland China box office, grossing 39.28 million yuan between November 16 and 22, according to data from the China Film Special Fund cited by Caixin. Released locally on November 20, the prequel ended a weeks-long reign by recent chart-toppers.

Based on Suzanne Collins' prequel novel, the film begins on the morning of the reaping for the 50th Hunger Games—set 24 years before the events of the original trilogy. Joseph Zada stars as a young Haymitch Abernathy.
